title: Three halvings in 30 days
caption: Activity A = 800·e^{−λt} falls 800 → 400 → 200 → 100 Bq. That is 3 halvings in 30 days, so the half-life is 30/3 = 10 days and λ = ln 2/10 = 0.0693 day⁻¹.
alt: Exponential decay curve of activity from 800 becquerel, passing 400 at 10 days, 200 at 20 days and 100 at 30 days.
description: Activity in becquerels against time in days: a falling exponential that never reaches zero.
Each 10-day step cuts the activity in half: 800 at 0 days, 400 at 10, 200 at 20, 100 at 30.
Three equal steps cover the 30 days, so t½ = 10 days, and λ = ln 2 / t½ = 0.0693 day⁻¹.
